messages:
Mia (SEO): Quick sync  we're tying the launch posts + benchmark narrative to inbound routing for the webinar. Need clear actionables for redirects, canonical, schema, and lead form attribution. Can we confirm owners?
Nora - Content: I'll finalize the narrative and where the CTAs point. Plan: two funnel CTAs — hero -> gated benchmark, footer -> webinar. Will mark exact anchor text and canonical targets in the doc.
Leo (Growth): Important: ensure form submissions carry page canonical + utm payload and a page_ref param so sales sees source. Prefer utm_source=organic-launch, utm_campaign=benchmark_apr24.
Sam P: Redirect plan: one canonical path per piece. We'll add 301s for legacy slugs and regex for trailing-slash variants. I'll put mapping in /seo/redirects.yaml in marketing repo. Example regex for trailing slash: ^/blog/(.*)/$ -> /blog/$1
Aj: Internal linking: follow cluster map. Pillar -> benchmark -> webinar sign-up. Use descriptive anchors and add data attributes (data-seo-anchor="pillar-to-benchmark"). Avoid site-wide footer links to the benchmark to prevent dilution.
Kevin (Dev): We can implement middleware to normalize URLs, set Link: rel=canonical header, and append page_ref to form POSTs via hidden input. We'll also add param striplist for ad-query params: fbclid, gclid, _gl, amp.
Mia (SEO): Schema checklist: Article schema on benchmark post, Event/WebinarEvent on landing, FAQPage with at least two Qs on the landing, and BreadcrumbList on both pages. Nora add suggested Qs.
Nora - Content: Will add 3 suggested FAQ Qs and the headline variants for A/B. Dropping the doc in #marketing-drafts in 15m.
Leo (Growth): For lead routing, make sure the CRM mapping includes page_ref and utm_campaign. If page_ref missing, route to generic launch queue. We'll add a validation rule in the webhook.
Sam P: I'll open PR for redirects + smoke tests that assert canonical header and 301 targets. Tests will include a sample legacy slug and trailing slash case.
Aj: I'll review the internal links and the anchor attributes once the draft is up. Also recommend we run a prelaunch crawl to catch broken anchors.
ops-bot: Reminder: prelaunch crawl scheduled in 48 hours after PR merge.
Mia (SEO): Target: all redirects + middleware + schema live 72 hours before webinar. I'll create a one-page QA checklist for launch ops (canonical header, redirect checks, schema present, UTMs, form params). Thanks everyone.
